name: apex-character-reference-spec
rule: Never rely on one photograph to define identity across angles. Use the full supported reference set for the task; single-image talking-avatar tools receive only one approved front image or the vendor-required source video.

landmarks.nose: near center vertical line for front view
landmarks.coordinate_status: visual guides only; actual per-image landmark coordinates must be measured or annotated

routing.image_video_generators: Use full sheet plus genuine photos only when the target tool supports multiple references; follow its input limits.
routing.talking_avatar_lipsync: Use slot A alone or the vendor-required source video; never use the grid sheet unless explicitly supported.
routing.three_d_photogrammetry: Use each supplied angle as a separate image tagged with yaw_deg and pitch_deg; confirm coordinate convention.
routing.digital_twin: Follow the vendor's required recording and consent flow; a reference sheet alone is not a substitute for source video.
routing.review: Compare front, three-quarter, and profile outputs against approved references; reject identity drift.

mac.status_note: Expected path only; fetch returned NOT_FOUND during verification. Do not claim the image is committed until verified.

coordinate_convention.yaw_deg: 0=front; negative=subject turns to their left; positive=subject turns to their right; +/-90=profile; 180=back
coordinate_convention.roll_deg: 0=level; confirm axis convention with each target tool
